summary: Round-2 follow-up at a3852808a: the publication hardening and final-check additions are correct and introduce no regressions. pilot_admin.acceptance_gate() runs after the review/blob provenance checks and before preflight() and the journal open, so a missing or wrong destination acceptance report fails closed before any Kerberos/logbook access or os.link. It requires status pass, kind destination, root resolving to the staging directory, step_counts == COUNTS ([1000]*30), event_count == EVENTS (30000), 60 samples, sample equality with the source report, reference_sha256 equal to the actual source report hash, and script_sha256 on both reports equal to the sha256 of the acceptance.py blob at the reviewed commit (which is also byte-compared to the working file). Both report paths and hashes are written in the journal preflight record. post_publish.py is read-only (GET-only monkeypatch, PS_FAKESTEP_FLAG=0, PS_PARALLEL=none), re-stats all 20 run-1 files from preflight.json via check_stat, requires every staged file to share dev/inode/size with its final path, requires exactly the 20 expected run-2 paths in the destination glob, and reads one calibrated event via the normal DataSource comparing raw/calib fingerprints to the first source sample. Source acceptance evidence is consistent: source_samples.json has 60 raw/calib sample pairs and 23 id_doc selections, kind source, event_count 60, PS_FAKESTEP_FLAG 0, and a recorded script_sha256; source_reference_summary.json binds it to a644240e0. unit_checks_round2.log shows 11/11 OK including the new gate test (7 negatives + valid). Dispositions: S5-ADMIN-01 resolved (stronger than requested), S5-ADMIN-02 resolved pending execution after publication, S5-EVID-01 resolved (script matches the logged output), S5-ACCEPT-01 deferral accepted: the hard-coded 1000 agrees with COUNTS, divergence would fail loudly via the count==1000 and docstring checks rather than silently, and changing acceptance.py now would invalidate the already executed source report's script hash binding. One new low, non-blocking test-coverage note (S5-TEST-01). Operational note: publish() byte-compares pilot_admin.py against the --commit blob, so publication must cite a3852808a (this review) rather than a644240e0, whose pilot_admin.py predates the gate. Full generation, full validation, destination acceptance, publication and post_publish execution remain pending and are not claimed.
